description: yagami is a self-hosted gateway that exposes the coding-agent CLIs already installed and signed in on a machine (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Gemini CLI, and any ACP agent) as an Anthropic- and OpenAI-compatible API. It also ships a zero-config library so local apps can drive those CLIs without URLs or API keys. Intended for personal use only.
features: Serves Anthropic /v1/messages and OpenAI /v1/chat/completions with one API key
Drives signed-in Claude Code via the Agent SDK, no separate vendor keys
Drives Codex via codex exec and ACP-registry agents via Agent Client Protocol
Zero-config Yagami library client mirroring Anthropic and OpenAI SDK surfaces
Library syncs with the host's yagami config file and environment variables
Anthropic server tools web_search and web_fetch run inside the engine
MCP connector: mcp_servers and mcp_toolset connect tools for a single turn
Streaming SSE responses synthesized in both Anthropic and OpenAI dialects
Full agentic Claude Code sessions embeddable for building UIs
Session cache maps conversation prefixes to Claude Code session ids for resume
Detects installed and signed-in CLIs and reports harness status
Settings parity modes: terminal, project, or isolated config loading

layers.name: Packaging and CLI
layers.what: Node CLI built with commander; start, stop, status, key, daemon mode; tsup bundling to dist/cli.js

layers.name: HTTP server
layers.what: Hono app on @hono/node-server; routes for Anthropic and OpenAI dialects, key auth, server config and state files

layers.name: Engine
layers.what: YagamiEngine core: request normalization, prefix keys, provider routing, SSE synthesis, error mapping

layers.name: Library client
layers.what: Zero-config Yagami client, host config loading, harness listing, Claude Code session wrapper

layers.name: Provider adapters
layers.what: Provider interface and adapters: Claude Agent SDK, codex exec, ACP, print and JSONL process runners, queues

layers.name: Diagnostics
layers.what: Logging sink for swallowed failures; the one place caught errors are reported

layers.name: Node runtime
layers.what: Node 20+ with Bun for install and build; Claude Code, Codex and ACP CLIs installed on the host

flows.name: A server tool or MCP turn
steps: Claude Code CLI with WebSearch, WebFetch or MCP servers
mcp_tool_use and mcp_tool_result blocks in reply

layout: src/cli.ts — yagami binary entry: commander commands
src/index.ts — library entry: Yagami, YagamiEngine, claudeCodeSession exports
src/server.ts — startYagami: wires engine, session cache and Hono app
src/server/config.ts — config file, API key, server state paths
src/core/engine.ts — YagamiEngine, the central request handler
src/core/providers/ — one adapter per CLI or protocol
src/core/transcript.ts — request normalization and prefix keys
test/ — vitest suites, with test/providers/ and test/helpers/fakeProvider.ts
scripts/ — smoke and live checks against real CLIs
run: make — bun install, build, and link yagami into ~/.local/bin
make update — stop running server, rebuild, reinstall, restart it
yagami start — run the server; first run generates and saves an API key
bun run dev — run the CLI from source with tsx
bun run build — bundle with tsup into dist/
bun run smoke / live:providers / live:session / live:harnesses — script checks in scripts/
conventions: Package manager is bun; the Makefile runs bun install and bun run build
prepublishOnly must pass typecheck and test before publish
Keep the endpoint private and do not share API keys (README)
